{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Tomorrow's news today.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:07.660
    | text      = We are now entering the 100th and eighth day of the return of the West via the American
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:13.579
    | text      = Republic 1776 worldwide.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:16.339
    | text      = I am your host Alex Jones, company from deep in the heart of Texas broadcasting worldwide.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:21.540
    | text      = Now I got up this morning and saw splash all over corporate media, everywhere, Bill Gates's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:26.620
    | text      = big comeback, he thinks, or his, his, his, his, his, his, his, his big assault.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:32.460
    | text      = And he has singled out Elon Musk to say, Elon Musk is doing everything that Bill Gates has
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:39.419
    | text      = done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.860
    | text      = So it's that classic meme of where you've got Indiana Jones with the golden idol and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:47.340
    | text      = he's trying to switch it out with the sand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:50.659
    | text      = And that's exactly what's happening here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:52.340
    | text      = I mean, it is incredible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:55.139
    | text      = And what's amazing is I woke up at 5 AM and saw this everywhere hours later, kept looking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:59.700
    | text      = and right before the shoot went live was looking.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.340
    | text      = No one even seems to understand what's going on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:05.220
    | text      = Even people that don't like Bill Gates don't understand how he operates, what his foundation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:09.299
    | text      = does, and what he's doing right here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:12.980
    | text      = I mean, Bill Gates runs the world population control foundation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:18.779
    | text      = They changed the name in 2000 of the Bill and Melinda Gates foundation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:24.500
    | text      = So we've talked, we've talked about this in the past, but Alex just got that thing about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:28.179
    | text      = the name of the Gates foundation from a meme that he saw on Twitter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:31.519
    | text      = It's not true, which would give some indication about how seriously one should take his coverage
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:35.539
    | text      = of this story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:37.059
    | text      = So Bill Gates came out and announced that he was going to close the Gates foundation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:40.740
    | text      = at the end of 2045.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:42.580
    | text      = And in the time until then, he was going to give away virtually all of his money, approximately
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:47.019
    | text      = $200 billion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:48.860
    | text      = I have no interest in deifying Bill Gates, but this kind of makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.299
    | text      = Trump has made clear that public health, particularly investing in health in other countries, isn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:58.580
    | text      = something that he's interested in funding, which really makes Bill Gates's work hard
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:02.960
    | text      = to do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.059
    | text      = He discussed the problem that getting rid of USAID represented earlier this year, saying,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.220
    | text      = quote, getting those people out there in their depth of experience, that's an asset that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:13.799
    | text      = would be very hard to recreate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.399
    | text      = He was essentially saying that if Trump flips that switch, it'll cause giant problems that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:20.480
    | text      = can't be solved by just re-flipping the switch.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:23.820
    | text      = I think that Gates is right here, but I also don't really care about him all that much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:28.539
    | text      = And this is where Alex's show has become deeply pathetic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:32.159
    | text      = This isn't really even talking about what Gates did or didn't do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:35.379
    | text      = This is all happening because Gates insulted Elon Musk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:39.139
    | text      = He said, quote, the picture of the world's richest man killing the world's poorest children
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.720
    | text      = is not a pretty one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:45.279
    | text      = So Alex has to lead the show with this or else, you know, he won't be doing his job.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:49.519
    | text      = Yeah, but it would be nice to watch the poorest children in the world kill the richest man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:54.240
    | text      = It does go both ways.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:55.639
    | text      = Sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:56.639
    | text      = Eventually you'd hope that that would be a picture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:00.960
    | text      = Man, if they just ate him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:02.799
    | text      = Just, oh boy, Lord of the Fly style.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:05.379
    | text      = This should be a good opportunity for Alex to reflect a little bit about the kind of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:09.000
    | text      = coverage that he does, because Gates directly indicted some of Alex's storylines that he's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.440
    | text      = had a hand in promoting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.240
    | text      = He said this to the New York Times of Musk's actions with Doge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.879
    | text      = Quote, they cut money to Gaza province in Mozambique.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:24.779
    | text      = That's really for drugs, so mothers don't give their babies HIV.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:28.519
    | text      = But the people doing the cutting are geographically illiterate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:31.399
    | text      = So they think it's Gaza and condoms.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:35.279
    | text      = Will they go to meet those babies who got HIV because the money was cut?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:39.120
    | text      = Probably not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.120
    | text      = A recent Lancet study estimated that in the next five years, the cuts to USAID are likely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.779
    | text      = to result in half a million more children needlessly being born with HIV.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:48.840
    | text      = And that's only one piece of the damage that Trump and Musk are doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:52.539
    | text      = If you read Gates' interview in the Times, it's pretty clear what his thinking is here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:57.620
    | text      = We have idiots in charge now, but they won't always be in charge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.620
    | text      = Gates believes that him spending more money now to try to fill that gap will make it so
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:05.700
    | text      = that public health issues the world faces don't become unsolvable before a new administration
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:10.639
    | text      = takes back over the government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.279
    | text      = Whether you want to believe his motives or not, that is what he's clearly expressing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.379
    | text      = And that makes some sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:19.019
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:20.019
    | text      = I mean, I'm all for it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.220
    | text      = Like logically, I see where he's coming from.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:26.379
    | text      = But there is a large part of me that says it's 2025 and to hear a billionaire be sanctimonious
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:32.820
    | text      = about anything makes me rabid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.940
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.940
    | text      = I don't, I'm not naive enough to believe in like fully altruistic motives.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:42.460
    | text      = But at the same time, I don't, I'm not cynical enough to believe that this is all just like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:47.779
    | text      = I need to hide my money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.980
    | text      = Yeah, absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:49.980
    | text      = I mean, you know, there's one part of me says go for it and I'm all for it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:55.779
    | text      = And the other part of me is foaming at the mouth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:57.860
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:58.860
    | text      = So what's that part of you is always going to be foaming?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:00.460
    | text      = Yeah, it's never going to not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:02.220
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:03.220
    | text      = So Bill Gates, he kills children like he's accusing Musk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:07.259
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:08.259
    | text      = So he's accused Elon Musk of killing children with USAID cuts when on record just pull it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:14.899
    | text      = up Reuters AP, but had to admit it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:18.580
    | text      = Headline the majority of polio cases worldwide caused by the vaccine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:24.740
    | text      = And then you read the articles, the documents, it's Bill Gates's worldwide polio program.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:29.740
    | text      = If Alex had a good argument about this stuff, you really think he wouldn't just constantly

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:33.740
    | text      = go back to this single example of a headline that he's misrepresenting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:37.860
    | text      = If Bill Gates and polio vaccines were really causing so much polio, I would expect that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:42.340
    | text      = Alex would be able to point to other pieces of data than just this headline.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:46.679
    | text      = He can't go any deeper than the headline because this is a parlor trick Alex is playing and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:51.139
    | text      = he knows that any further information reveals that fraud to the audience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:55.460
    | text      = And I just wish he'd get into any numbers, even the basic stats, like how there were
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:59.779
    | text      = 16,000 cases of polio in the United States per year before the vaccine was developed

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:07.259
    | text      = That is an issue.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:14:08.259
    | text      = Eradicated.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = That is an issue.

{{TranscriptBlock
